meta.description: Camera-session groups of the organizer's dataset: videos whose static background (median frame over the clip, 24x44 (w x h) grayscale) correlates at >= 0.92 share a setup. Produced by ml/analysis/scene_groups.py on 2026-10-18. Use for group-aware cross-validation (leave-one-setup-out): a held-out setup approximates the jury's 'different camera angle' condition better than leave-one-video-out, because every setup contains violation/normal twin recordings of the same scene.

notes.S2: darker (mean gray 122-126 vs ~138 elsewhere); camera physically moves inside Х-11 and Х-12 (first-vs-last background correlation drops by 0.5)
